_readme: Where wild mushrooms generate: brown and red colonies, inky cap and morel (patch, colony, huge), at the surface and
in caves. Applied at world load by kubejs/server_scripts/worldgen/mushroom_spawns.js (CEConfig [worldgen.systems]
mushroomSpawns). Rejoin the world after editing; only chunks generated afterwards change.
Plan: feature_writeup/fungi_delight.md section 5.1.1. Resolved biome lists: feature_writeup/crops_by_biome.md
(python3 tools/gen_crop_worldgen_table.py).
Biome words: the "biomes" table of wild_crops.json (same traits, same clause rules).
rules: one entry per biome list.
mode: surface (vegetal_decoration; biomes marked ocean or cave never match) or cave (underground_decoration;
every biome can match, the placed features search a cave floor below sea level and 13+ blocks under the surface).
where / add / except / features / disable_modifiers / label / notes: as in wild_crops.json.
Rates live in the placed features (development/creativeWorldgen packs/<modid>/data/creativeworldgen/worldgen/placed_feature/wild/mushrooms/):
sparse = dark forest and swamps: patch 1 in 1365, colony 1 in 60, huge 1 in 7 chunks: a quarter of the mean of
brown and red there (patches 1/256 and 1/512, FD colonies 1/15 each, huge 16 x 2.5% and 16 x 4.9% per chunk
from dark_forest_vegetation);
fields = mushroom fields, Fungi Delight's defaults: inky cap 16 / 15 / 3, morel 12 / 15 / 4;
cave patches 1 in 1024 (a third of the mean vanilla brown/red patch rate), cave colonies 1 in 120 (an eighth of
the 1 in 15 surface colony); a rolled cave chunk tries 8 floor spots.
Cave carrots (Miner's Delight) are the cave_carrots rule: three Y bands (core -24 to 24 1 in 2 chunks, deep -64 to -25 1 in 5,
high 25 to 44 1 in 8; 8 floor spots tried per rolled chunk), nothing above Y 48. Placed features: placed_feature/wild/cave_carrots/.
Vanilla's own brown and red patches and huge mushrooms are not touched.

brown_mushroom_colony.label: Brown Mushroom Colony
brown_mushroom_colony.notes: Pack feature: FD's own needs mycelium; this one also takes podzol/grass in shade (dark forest floor). Moved here from wild_crops.json.

inky_cap_dark_forest.label: Inky Cap (dark forest)
inky_cap_dark_forest.notes: Patch 1 in 1365, colony 1 in 60, huge 1 in 7 chunks: a quarter of the brown/red rates there.

morel_dark_forest_swamp.label: Morel (dark forest, swamps)
morel_dark_forest_swamp.notes: Same rates as inky cap in the dark forest. Swamps have the same brown/red patches as the dark forest (Terralith's swamp-only patches place nothing) and no FD colony, so the dark forest colony rate is used.

inky_cap_mushroom_fields.label: Inky Cap (mushroom fields)
inky_cap_mushroom_fields.notes: Fungi Delight's rates: patch 1 in 16, colony 1 in 15, huge 1 in 3 chunks.

morel_mushroom_fields.label: Morel (mushroom fields)
morel_mushroom_fields.notes: Fungi Delight's rates: patch 1 in 12, colony 1 in 15, huge 1 in 4 chunks.

cave_patches.label: Inky Cap and Morel (caves)
cave_patches.notes: Every overworld biome. 1 in 1024 chunks each; a rolled chunk tries 8 cave floor spots (crops_by_biome.md counts all 8 as attempts, most land in rock). On the plant's own placeable_on tag (stone included).

cave_colonies.label: Mushroom colonies (caves)
cave_colonies.notes: Every overworld biome. 1 in 120 chunks each; a rolled chunk tries 8 cave floor spots (crops_by_biome.md counts all 8 as attempts, most land in rock). Only on #minecraft:mushroom_grow_block or #minecraft:dirt (moss, rooted dirt, dirt pockets), never on bare stone.

cave_carrots.label: Cave Carrots (caves)
cave_carrots.notes: Miner's Delight wild cave carrots, every overworld biome, never above Y 48 (patch origin Y 44 at most; a patch spreads 3 up). Three bands, each 1 in N chunks, 8 floor spots tried: core Y -24 to 24 1 in 2, deep Y -64 to -25 1 in 5, high Y 25 to 44 1 in 8 (per Y layer the deep and high bands are about half the core density). On stone, deepslate or dirt, in noise caves and in carver caves (air and cave_air; the mushrooms are noise caves only). The Miner's port ships no modifier of its own (upstream: 1 in 3 chunks, Y -54 to 48, no cave check).
